source.title: Feliks Zemdegs wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015
source.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01) won the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2015) with an average of 7.56 seconds. [Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) finished second (8.56) and [Jakub Kipa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010KIPA01) finished third (8.63).  
 World records: Feliks Zemdegs 7x7 Cube 2:23.55 (single), 7x7 Cube 2:33.73 (average), Jan Bentlage Skewb 1.68 (single), Kevin Hays 6x6 Cube 1:46.41 (average), 6x6 Cube 1:45.98 (average).  
 Oceanian records: Feliks Zemdegs Rubik's Cube 5.60 (single), Rubik's Cube 5.39 (single), Megaminx 50.75 (average), Jayden McNeill 3x3 with feet 1:20.35 (single), 3x3 with feet 1:32.15 (average).  
 European records: Michał Pleskowicz 3x3 one-handed 8.48 (single).  
 North American records: Kevin Hays 5x5 Cube 51.26 (single), 5x5 Cube 55.66 (average), 7x7 Cube 2:30.35 (single).  
 South American records: Felipe Rueda Hernández Megaminx 51.24 (average), Gianfranco Huanqui 3x3 blindfolded 21.83 (single), 5x5 blindfolded 13:53.00 (single), João Pedro Batista Ribeiro Costa 3x3 fewest moves 25.67 (average), Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez 6x6 Cube 2:07.81 (average), 7x7 Cube 3:11.59 (single), 7x7 Cube 3:28.92 (average), 7x7 Cube 3:33.26 (average), Pedro Henrique da Silva Roque 4x4 Cube 27.73 (single), 4x4 Cube 32.15 (average), 5x5 Cube 1:03.32 (average).

translation.title: Feliks Zemdegs 夺得 2015 年魔方世锦赛冠军
translation.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01)以 7.56 秒的平均成绩夺得 [2015 年魔方世锦赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2015)冠军。[Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01)以 8.56 秒获得亚军，[Jakub Kipa](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010KIPA01)以 8.63 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：七阶单次 2:23.55、平均 2:33.73；Jan Bentlage：斜转单次 1.68；Kevin Hays：六阶平均 1:46.41、平均 1:45.98。

**大洋洲纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：三阶单次 5.60、单次 5.39，五魔方平均 50.75；Jayden McNeill：三阶脚拧单次 1:20.35、平均 1:32.15。

**欧洲纪录：**Michał Pleskowicz：三阶单手单次 8.48。

**北美洲纪录：**Kevin Hays：五阶单次 51.26、平均 55.66，七阶单次 2:30.35。

**南美洲纪录：**Felipe Rueda Hernández：五魔方平均 51.24；Gianfranco Huanqui：三阶盲拧单次 21.83、五阶盲拧单次 13:53.00；João Pedro Batista Ribeiro Costa：三阶最少步平均 25.67；Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez：六阶平均 2:07.81，七阶单次 3:11.59、平均 3:28.92、平均 3:33.26；Pedro Henrique da Silva Roque：四阶单次 27.73、平均 32.15，五阶平均 1:03.32。
